descriptionChirho: General action sense of Qal עשׂה: to do, perform, carry out a deed or command (Arabic faʿala فَعَلَ), encompassing all inflections of the basic 'to do' meaning including imperatives, imperfects, perfects, infinitives, participles denoting doers/agents of action, executing judgments, and dealing with persons.

To make, build, or construct a physical object or structure (Arabic ṣanaʿa صَنَعَ), including crafting tabernacle furnishings, fashioning idols, building altars, preparing provisions, and all manufacturing or artisanal activity.
To work or labor at a task or occupation (Arabic ʿamila عَمِلَ), emphasizing sustained effort or employment rather than a single act, often with Swahili kufanya-kazi 'to do work'.
Niphal passive of עשׂה: to be done, be made, be performed (Arabic yuṣnaʿu يُصنَعُ / yufʿalu يُفعَلُ), expressing that an action or product results without specifying the agent.
To produce or yield agricultural fruit or crops (Arabic yuntiju يُنتِجُ), a specialized sense where the land or vine 'makes' produce, with Swahili kuzaa 'to bear/bring forth'.
Substantival participial use denoting God or a human as Maker/Creator (Arabic ṣāniʿ صَانِع), functioning as a divine title or agent noun for the one who fashioned creation or a person.
